item.title: Busy Philipps talks about treating her brain tumor and filming a new show
item.description: On Wild Card, Philipps unpacks the experience of treating her brain tumor and filming her new show, the CBS drama Cupertino. But she also opened up about another aspect of her life.
item.content:encoded: On Wild Card, Philipps unpacks the experience of treating her brain tumor and filming her new show, the CBS drama Cupertino. But she also opened up about another aspect of her life.

item.title: Pope Leo begins a 12-day, 3-country South America tour after his cancer surgery
item.description: Pope Leo begins his first South American tour since lung cancer surgery. The 12-day journey takes him to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, where he spent two decades.

item.title: 'Club Kid' dances to the rhythm of its own drum and bass
item.description: There's every reason to be wary of Club Kid, one of those manchild-must-grow-up-when-a-cute-kid-shows-up stories. But Jordan Firstman's directorial debut is different.

item.title: Remembering 'Star Trek' actor Patrick Stewart
item.description: Stewart, who died Oct. 28, performed with the Royal Shakespeare Company before becoming famous as Star Trek's Picard. Critic David Bianculli has a tribute, and we listen back to a 2020 interview.

item.title: 'Wild Horse Nine' turns CIA dirty work into a tiresome tale of bickering tourists
item.description: John Malkovich and Sam Rockwell star as CIA agents trying to topple Chilean democracy who take a side trip to Easter Island. Brace yourself for oddball twists, jolts of violence and profanity galore.

item.title: Past White House adviser Raj Panjabi has written a playbook for 'living room' crises
item.description: Dr. Raj Panjabi is the author of Safer: A Playbook. His goal is to help people face a personal crisis — health, workplace, family conflicts — and "turn fear into action."

item.title: After cancer surgery, Pope Leo embarks on Latin America trip
item.description: Pope Leo XIV is kicking off a three-nation tour of Latin America with a visit to Uruguay, three weeks after undergoing lung cancer surgery that had put the entire trip into question.

item.title: A judge blocked construction of Trump's arch at the 11th hour. What's next?
item.description: The Trump administration had hoped to begin construction immediately after a federal panel approved its arch late Thursday. Overnight, the judge issued an order blocking work for 14 days.

item.title: A volunteer acting group made up of retirees delights people in senior living spaces
item.description: A group of retirees volunteers as actors to perform for seniors. We meet the Golden Guild of Michigan.

item.title: With humor, heart and homunculi, 'Small Prophets' is a gentle marvel
item.description: A man calls forth magical spirits in an effort to find his long-missing girlfriend in this new British comedy-fantasy. Original and surprising, Small Prophets imbues daily life with poetic touches.
